description: This file defines a test application factory for creating an in-memory test host for the DataAssetBackend minimal API. It customizes the web host environment for testing purposes, including environment setup, configuration to avoid database dependency, and a permissive authentication scheme for testing endpoints.

classes.name: TestAppFactory
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from WebApplicationFactory<Program> that configures a test host environment for the DataAssetBackend API, including environment setup, dummy database configuration, and test authentication scheme.

classes.name: TestAuthHandler
classes.description: A private sealed class within TestAppFactory implementing a custom authentication handler that provides a mock authenticated principal with multiple roles for testing purposes.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the default web host configuration to set environment variables, configure app settings to avoid database dependency, and register a permissive test authentication scheme.

methods.name: HandleAuthenticateAsync
methods.description: Provides a mocked authentication result with a ClaimsPrincipal that includes multiple roles to ensure endpoint authorization policies pass during testing.
